what: The video's override moment. C0072 is one of the 5 attacks the desk wrongly closes at the default knob (a UDP-bypass-v1 flood). An analyst spot-checking closed cases relabels it; the nearby-attack rule then stops the desk from auto-closing three look-alike flows, which go to the analyst instead. Those three are benign in the dataset, so the cost is three extra decisions, not three caught attacks. scripts/record_agent.py --demo-path records model runs for exactly these label states.
